highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 introduces Graphite GPU rendering and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to m152 and VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0, retaining the allocator fallback used by SkiaSharp callers.
Includes a same-milestone native refresh without changing the managed API or tracked dependency versions.

Adds explicit record, snap, insert, and submit APIs for Graphite with Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn contexts, including browser WebGPU. Existing Ganesh APIs remain unchanged; Graphite pixel readback uses the asynchronous API.

SKImage and SKSurface.RequestReadPixels deliver callback-scoped RGBA results with copy-out helpers. Raster callbacks run synchronously; Ganesh work must be submitted and drained with GRContext.CheckAsyncWorkCompletion. Results become invalid after the callback returns.
Ships SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET with typed backend-context helpers, including Android-capable Vulkan loading. GRVkExtensions can be constructed publicly; the SharpVk integration remains available.
The FreeType-backed Nano Server native build can render typefaces loaded from files, streams, or data. It still has no system font discovery, so applications must supply fonts explicitly.
Produces separate Apple native symbol packages with complete dSYM bundles and gives Android libraries deterministic split-debug identities. Apple customer packages remain free of dSYM payloads.
Region iterators retain their source region, and pixmap subsets and With* results retain the ultimate pixel owner, preventing premature finalization while those views are in use.
Frees raster pixel allocations when SKImage.Create fails, disposes the previous uniform buffer on Reset, and releases consumed non-memory-backed stream assets when their HarfBuzz blob is released.

SKData.SaveTo avoids an intermediate copy on span-capable targets, Font.Shape reuses caller feature arrays, and tag formatting avoids char boxing. Text encoding, uniform lookup construction, and native-wrapper registration also avoid redundant work.
Releases the native cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owner, avoiding an unlock through freed memory.
Includes m151 native font-rendering and Ganesh fixes, including failure handling that prevents readbacks from returning stale texture data.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Enabled explicit font loading and rendering in the FreeType-backed Nano Server build.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Reduced Windows native build overhead by initializing the MSVC environment once per build.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Restored production of the Silk.NET Vulkan package and added separate Apple native symbol packages. Reduced shaping and tag-formatting allocation and fixed uniform-buffer and stream-asset cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Introduced Graphite rendering, asynchronous pixel readback, Silk.NET Vulkan helpers, and explicit font loading on Nano Server. Also fixed region/pixmap owner lifetimes and raster-image failure cleanup.

harfbuzz_summary: Avoids copying caller-owned feature arrays during shaping and removes char boxing from tag formatting. Adds separate Apple native symbol packages and deterministic Android debug identities; native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite rendering and asynchronous pixel readback.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It adds Silk.NET Vulkan helpers and explicit font loading on Nano Server, alongside the Skia m152 update. Region iterators and pixmap views now retain their native data owners.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: This release candidate adds native debugging symbols and reduces shaping allocations.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It restores production of the Silk.NET Vulkan package, adds separate Apple symbol packages, and corrects Android debug identities. Uniform resets and HarfBuzz blob release now clean up their previous native resources promptly.

v4.152.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 corrects native cached-data teardown after the release candidate.
v4.152.0.body: The mutex guard is released before its owner is deleted. This shipment also includes release-infrastructure updates; Graphite and asynchronous readback were introduced in the earlier preview.
